name: Okta Workforce Identity
summary: Okta Workforce Identity starts at $6 per user per month, billed annually, with a $1,500 annual contract minimum. Adaptive MFA is an add-on on the Starter suite and is included from Core Essentials ($14 per user a month) upward.

evidence.capability: context-based access policies with risk checks

facts.text: Okta describes Adaptive MFA contextual access policies that assess devices, networks, locations, user behavior and IP addresses, and can deny access based on failing device conditions.
Okta's Privileged Access page describes vaulting of local server account passwords, SSH and RDP session recording, and temporary, time-bound just-in-time access.
Okta's Workforce Identity pricing has a $1,500 annual contract minimum, and every suite is billed annually.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: Adaptive MFA, Privileged Access and Lifecycle Management are add-ons. Adaptive MFA has no published price

plans.name: Core Essentials
plans.notes: Adaptive MFA and Lifecycle Management included. Privileged Access is an add-on

plans.name: Essentials
